title: A lean formalization of Roy's strong six exponentials theorem
summary: We formalize in Lean 4 with Mathlib Roy's strong six exponentials theorem: if $x_1,x_2$ are linearly independent over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ and $y_1,y_2,y_3$ are linearly independent over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$, then one of the six products $x_iy_j$ lies outside the $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$-vector space spanned by $1$ and the logarithms of algebraic numbers. The proof closure uses only Lean's three standard axioms.
